members.name: Chris Cox
members.title: Lead Child & Youth Program Coordinator
members.bio: Chris Cox leads the Iowa Army National Guard Child & Youth Program. He grew up in a Guard family, loves cheering on Guard kids, and teams up with Erin to plan statewide programs that keep families supported.

members.name: Erin Coogler
members.title: Child & Youth Program Coordinator
members.bio: Erin Coogler is the Program Coordinator who brings a child-development background and a big heart for Guard families. Working alongside Chris at Camp Dodge, she helps design statewide camps, kits, and trainings—and meets families on the road when regional events pop up.
